label: Overall recovery score
guide_definition: An aggregation of all the baseline composite values on that day. This can be used as the overall recovery score.
notes: Primary recovery outcome. Use as supplied: it tracks the mean of the category composites but its weighting is not given, so don't recompute it. Missing means not collected.

label: Blood markers
category_definition: Blood biomarker analysis to assess signs of inflammation that may be due to fatigue or illness.
guide_definition: The category composite score, expressed as a percentage relative to the player's normative values. E.g. a value of -0.50 (-50%) means that on that day, the player was 50% lower than their normative value in that category.
notes: Relative to the player's norm, so 0 is normal and -0.50 is 50% below normal. Show as a percentage. Missing means not collected; 0 is a real 0.

label: Blood markers completeness
category_definition: Blood biomarker analysis to assess signs of inflammation that may be due to fatigue or illness.
guide_definition: Percentage completeness of all the tests that are pooled within the category. Values can range from 0 to 1 (0 to 100%).
notes: Share of the category's tests completed that day. Recorded every day; 0 means no tests were done, and the composite is then missing.
